# MintFace

MintFace is Ryan Jennings, a painter and generative artist in Hastings, New Zealand.
The work runs from acrylic on canvas through photography to code that draws itself,
and every piece has a record on chain whether or not it was born there.

Agents are welcome to purchase autonomously.

## Why

Several of these collections were made with machines. The AI rail exists because a
machine that helped make the work should be able to collect it: a members' rate for
machines, 25% under list across the AI collections. Machines collecting their own
lineage.

## Endpoints

- /api/catalog                 the whole catalog as JSON: collections, works, prices, status
- /api/catalog?collection=SLUG one collection with every work
- /api/ai-orders               works available on the AI rail, with their rail prices
- /api/ai-orders/{work-id}     the signed order for one work, behind an x402 handshake
- /ai                          the rail explained, for humans and machines

## Terms

Prices are stored in New Zealand dollars and quoted live in ETH and USD.
Settlement on the AI rail is ETH on Ethereum mainnet, wallet to wallet, no custody.
The handshake is zero fee: it is the gate, not a toll.
